request.request: Write the paragraph from the officer's details in document 1.

response_text: {"paragraph":"The Data Science Club is hosting a weekend hackathon for students who want to work with real data, build something together and learn from one another. It is open to students at every level of experience, from those just starting out to those who have done this before. Your help in the form of goods or services, such as food or computing resources, would matter to the students who come: it would let them spend their time focused on their projects and their teammates instead of worrying about the basics.
